The Lazy White Tiger and the Boy

description:
"I want you to teach me how to have sex, Lady White Tiger." White Tiger, one of the Four Guardian Deities, finds everything bothersome except sleeping. One day, Heesu, her contractor, who has always been kind and gentle, makes a wish on his twentieth birthday. He wants her to teach him how to have sex. Naturally, White Tiger refuses. But then Heesu smiles, revealing the true intentions he has been hiding all along. Catnip scattered throughout the room. Her mind begins to grow hazy. Tiger ears and a tail suddenly emerge. "Just relax and enjoy the catnip, Lady White Tiger. I'll take care of devouring you myself. You can even fall asleep while we're doing it. That's fine, right?" That night, the lazy White Tiger finally realizes the truth. The one she had been looking after all these years was never an innocent boy— but a beast who had patiently waited twelve long years for the chance to devour her.
